{{Quote|Hindred knows a dozen bolt holes, both in system and out.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="SE" />}}
'''Hindred''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He worked with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], who sent the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Spero]] to him, in order for Hindred to arrange a bolt hole for the gardener to stay, protected from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] pursuit.<ref name="SE" />
